raw_segments.text: Lady Macbeth, my hands are of your color, but I shame to wear a heart so white, knocking
I hear knocking at the south entry, retire we to our chamber.
A little water clears us of this deed.
Your constancy hath left you unattended.
Get on your nightgown, lest occasion call us and show us to be watchers.
Be not lost so poorly in your thoughts.
